threshold_selection.rule: Largest support-margin threshold retaining at least 90% of calibration in-scope images; acceptance uses margin >= threshold.
threshold_selection.ties: All margins equal to the threshold are accepted; recall can exceed the target.

encoding_timing.definition: Shared batched image encoding only; not separate baseline/optimized latency, and excludes downloads, text-feature setup, scoring, Flask and browser upload.

summary.sampling: Fixed within-class offsets 20..39 calibration and 100..119 holdout for nine supported families; offsets 20..29 and 100..109 for eight calibration-seen out-of-scope classes; 100..109 for eight additional holdout out-of-scope classes. Every row label and image hash verified before inference, with no post-prediction substitutions.
limitations: An application inference optimization; no CLIP weight fine-tuning was performed.
This predeclared Food-101 subset is not a representative real-world accuracy estimate.
Ramen correctness is family-only; the dataset cannot establish tonkotsu versus shoyu subtype accuracy.
Additional holdout OOD classes have no calibration photos, but their class names may be in the predefined background candidates; this is not unseen-label OOD generalization.
All images are food; non-food, mixed-dish and real user uploads remain untested in this comparison.
Food-101 validation is held out from Food-101 training; CLIP pretraining overlap is unknown.
Relative softmax values are not calibrated correctness probabilities.
The original forced-choice baseline accepts every photo; rejection improves safety at the cost of some supported-food coverage.
